en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 8. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Mughīrah, from ‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir, from Abān, from Ibn Muskān, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Allāh will register those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) among those (who will be) in ‘Illīyyīn.
